subject: The one feature 90% of users skip (big mistake)
preview_text: Most people download Smart Notes and immediately miss the secret weapon. It's not the AI summary. It's this.
body_paragraphs: I watched a user last week. They had a 45-minute strategy call. Our AI captured every word, generated a perfect summary with action items. They opened the app, glanced at the summary, and closed it. They missed the entire point. I almost yelled at my screen.

Here's the truth: the AI summary is just the surface. It's what everyone sees. The real magic, the thing that actually saves you 5+ hours a week, happens after you think you're done. It's the part that connects the dots you didn't even know were related. Most people are so relieved to have the summary, they stop there. They're using a race car to go get the mail.

Open your last meeting note. Don't just read the summary. Look at the very bottom. See that small, almost hidden section labeled 'Connections'? Click it. That's the feature. While you were in your meeting, our AI was quietly cross-referencing every point, name, and deadline with every other note you've ever taken. It found the hidden links you missed.

Tap the button below. Open your last note, find 'Connections,' and see what it found. It takes 8 seconds. It will show you the thread you didn't know you were holding. P.S. The user from last week? They found a critical project dependency buried in a casual comment from two months ago. Their boss now thinks they're psychic.
